source_bases: existing scratch RQ4 k=4 checkpoints; not retrained

seed_formulas.note: Video IDs were not stored in historical JSONs. Selections are reconstructed from windows.csv first-appearance order plus the original seed formulas, then accepted only if clip/window/category counts match the historical records.

prototype_embedding.window_embed: mean-pool Transformer hidden states over 64 frames (eval mode)
prototype_embedding.clip_support: mean of window embeddings that share video_id, then class-mean, then L2
prototype_embedding.test_score: L2-normalize each test *window* embedding, cosine vs class prototypes, then mean-pool window logits per video_id

git_note: Repository has no commits on master; outputs are isolated under results/paper1_access_revision/ instead of a git branch snapshot.
